name: Tyrannosaurus
description: A powerful apex predator built for controlling territory and setting the pace of an encounter.

name: Allosaurus
description: A strong mid-sized hunter built for pressure, pursuit and coordinated attacks.

name: Carnotaurus
description: Fast, aggressive and mobile. Carnotaurus thrives on finding openings before disappearing into the brush.

name: Ceratosaurus
description: A resilient scavenger that turns every carcass and shoreline into an opportunity.

name: Deinosuchus
description: A patient ambush predator that owns the waterline and punishes careless crossings.

name: Dilophosaurus
description: An adaptable predator that uses speed, venom and terrain to wear down prey.

name: Herrerasaurus
description: A nimble small carnivore made for quick strikes, stealth and opportunistic hunting.

name: Omniraptor
description: A flexible pack hunter with the tools to harass larger prey and control space.

name: Troodon
description: A social, dangerous little predator that becomes more threatening with numbers.

name: Pteranodon
description: A tireless flyer built for scouting coastlines, waterways and movement across the island.

name: Diabloceratops
description: A horned defender that holds its ground and protects the herd with confidence.

name: Dryosaurus
description: A fast, alert grazer that survives by reading the environment and moving early.

name: Tenontosaurus
description: A dependable herd dinosaur with a strong kick and a steady temperament.

name: Maiasaura
description: A social herd species that thrives through cooperation, awareness and steady travel.

name: Pachycephalosaurus
description: A compact brawler that turns a thick skull and fearless attitude into its defense.

name: Stegosaurus
description: A heavily defended herbivore whose tail makes it one of the valley's most respected survivors.

name: Triceratops
description: A powerful herd defender with the size, horns and resolve to meet the biggest threats.

name: Deinocheirus
description: A huge wetland specialist that combines reach, presence and an unpredictable edge.

name: Gallimimus
description: A quick-footed scout made for distance, awareness and keeping a herd moving.

name: Hypsilophodon
description: Small, alert and adaptable. The best defense is knowing when to move.

name: Beipiaosaurus
description: A curious forager that brings a different rhythm to the valley's food chain.
